name: Lin Horn Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Lin Horn Technology Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacture and distribution of printed circuit boards (PCBs). It provides double-sided printed circuit boards and multilayer printed circuit boards, which are applied in electronic component packaging and interconnection. Its products include computer peripheral, communication, HDI products, consumer electronics, automobile, industrial and medical equipment. The Company was founded on June 21, 1995 and is headquartered in Chiayi, Taiwan.
